title: Spielberg's EA game 'LMNO' about a woman with alien empathy powers

tellings.quote: >> The game was codenamed LM O, and it was about a woman who is human but has alien capabilities running around using the power of empathy uh to disarm people because the government is chasing her.

plain: Around 2004, the film director Steven Spielberg worked on a video game for the game company Electronic Arts, code-named LMNO, about a human woman with alien abilities who uses the power of empathy to disarm people while the government hunts her. Brent Friedman, a writer who says he was involved, tells Michels this himself, as part of a wider story about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs.
